items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: Yeah, Mr. R. He used to come.

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)

ctx.x: They're red. with brick dust? No, it's a coloring. I have some I can show you if you want to see. It's a coloring. You would like to see? Yeah, I've never seen that. It's a coloring. You see like the coloring with pavements and things. It's a coloring but it don't last as long. No, it washes off. It washes off easily. They had yellow too. They had yellow oak and red oak. Yellow oak and red oak. That's right. You had your choice. Red oak, yellow oak, you used on the steps. You used the yellow oak to put on the…

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: I didn't get fish fries, but I scrubbed with brick where I have wood to keep my wood nice and yellow oak. That's why I had that.
